received_works.body:
Hello Sensei! I was wondering if it would be possible for me to request a headshot of my OC?

The story takes place in a fantasy world.
Zember: A young ruin fairy. Her appearance looks like an attractive 17-year old girl and her height is 167cm. She has watchful cat-like amber eyes, pointed teeth and nails, there is an old scar that runs down her chest. In this world, ruin fairies are in charge of protecting the borders of fairyland and granting death to normal fairies when the time comes. Zember works as an assassin and also a spy. Her personality is playful and lively like a normal fairy, but serious and deadly when needed.
*Zember's hair is tied into a high ponytail. Her teeth are sharp. Please draw her without her weapon.
*Her main colours are gold, red and black.

I would like the frame to be a circle. I will leave the composition and details of the headshot up to Sensei! Please draw freely♥

Thank you so much for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rkuP9aQJt1evWLMK5LPBV33fmUXwpqxY

Hello again! I would love to be considered for another headshot!

This would be for my oc Echo!
He's kind of a protagonist type, mostly just wants to keep everyone happy, and can get kinda emotional, but he has a big heart! 

Feel free to have him waving, or making a peace sign (maybe with some sweat drops on his cheek?)

Thank you for your time!

https://sta.sh/22gfl2cfnezt?edit=1

Hello! Your art is so gorgeous, I would love to get a viewfinder commission from you! 

I was interested in getting art of my two ocs, Han and Leigh. Their references are here:
Han (170cm):
https://orig00.deviantart.net/0782/f/2018/242/b/2/010118_l_by_caephuier-dclku1c.png
https://f2.toyhou.se/file/f2-toyhou-se/images/32923432_1W9IdwMNIBei2tZ.png

Leigh (186 cm)
https://f2.toyhou.se/file/f2-toyhou-se/images/58058821_5jqyVpnIBHgJeyv.png?1674470354
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FomBtFMaMAAmYbO?format=jpg&name=large

They are both boys, but Han is androgynous! They're very happy and playful! They are in a romantic relationship. They like to explore in nature and old ruins, and dance together. they are both also very good at magic. I leave their clothing and poses up to you - the only specific request I have is that Leigh has freckles, and they both have their matching necklaces! The wings on Han are optional. I would like a scene of them spending time together, maybe on a cute date or quietly enjoying each others' company, but I leave the specifics up to you!

Thank you so much again!!

Hello! I love your painterly style and use of textures. I would like to request a Viewfinder halfbody commission of 2 characters. 

TRISTAN (183cm) is a young musician! He is a cheerful guy, but he is also prideful and lonely. He has a bright smile and freckles.

XUE (191cm) is a doctor! He is arrogant, playful, and a troublemaker. He has tan skin and a tattoo on his shoulder. 

They are friends with a complicated relationship. They argue a lot, but understand the other well. They are fond of each other, and hold intimate feelings.

Feel free to change their clothes to whatever you like. Both of them prefer simple clothing.

reference: https://sta.sh/220xawk33qc7

I would like if you drew a scene that is youthful and nostalgic! I like the composition of this previous work you did! https://prnt.sc/iKVdwp4W3DxE

If you feel that this request is too ambitious, feel free to resend the request with a higher price!

Hi! ^^ I'd love to get a framed headshot by you of my Final Fantasy 14 character, Mimina! She is a lalafell lady in her 20s, who is a bard by trade and lives in the forest city. Her personality is gentle, older sister and she tends to be either very quiet or talking a lot when she feels comfortable with someone.

These are her references: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VEM-V-bMrD9uu_HsqRy_YxZiZriVRziX?usp=sharing

Hello, I want to commission a framed headshot (circle)!

Reference: https://toyhou.se/17588658.hikan-ffxiv-?key=Wf7ibXSeSl9G20Y

Either of his outfits is fine, whichever you prefer! I am also not picky with pose/expression.

Thank you for considering my request!

hello! thank you for the opportunity, I'd like to request a framed headshot if accepted!

my oc is polite and tries to present himself as sophisticated, but on the inside he's a bit shy and sad. he's also easily flustered and quite awkward. feel free to draw him with or without his antlers!

https://toyhou.se/6994698.xueqing/gallery#50146876

Hello! Your style is very pretty, may I request an image of my FFXIV ship? 

"SLATE" ♀ 183 CM 
[ https://imgur.com/a/6pFiogB ] 
She is the warrior of light/protagonist, is a human who grew up from nothing. She is from a desert country that was invaded before she was born. She has long dark hair, toned tan skin, bright blue eyes and light freckles on her face. She is humble, helpful, kind and strong, but not very smart. 

"ARTOIREL" ♂ 206 CM 
[ https://imgur.com/a/4VAS1vr ]  
He is a devoted elven nobleman, serious, agreeable, and determined to keep the ones he loves safe. He takes his role as a knight very seriously and makes it his priority in life.

I would like to see them ball room dancing and looking into each other's eyes with uncertainty, vibes from this song linked below. It's a sense of unknown longing, as they both have unspoken feelings neither of them dares to act on due to their differing class status. They have a close relationship due to his family taking her in after an event in the game, and though they consider each other family, it's family in a different way than brother and sister.
 
Inspiration from this song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kH9kbcRCZH8

Any ballroom outfit for her is okay but he usually wears the coat in his reference. Thank you for considering me!

Hello again! I would like to request art of my character, Marion. She is elegant and mature, and has a sweet demeanor. She is an opera singer and her motifs are the sea and stars. She loves flowers like roses, forget-me-nots, hydrangeas, and campanulas.

https://toyhou.se/17994794.marion-fenech/55120878
https://toyhou.se/17994794.marion-fenech/gallery

I leave the pose and detailing up to you!

Thank you so much for your consideration!

Viewfinder, 2 characters, half body -- Axel is a gentle, bubbly medic. https://sta.sh/21wog38fk4my Dex is a loud, chaotic swashbuckler. https://sta.sh/01z5bfzw1xhh They are on a pirate crew together. Axel is patient with Dex, who can be too bold and outgoing. They are good friends.

HI PETITE I LOVE YOUR ART SO MUCH I want to request my ffxiv character if you don't mind!!

Reference: https://sta.sh/2k4bgzm1xkb

My character is the black-haired Au Ra. I'd like you to draw him in his NIN outfit.
If you'd like you can draw him with the white-haired Miqo'te boy that you can find him with in the references, but if you prefer to draw him solo I would love it if you can draw him with a white tiger (Byakko is his motif).
But otherwise please feel free to draw him however you like!!! I leave the composition up to you I trust you with my life!!!!!!

https://sta.sh/2k4bgzm1xkb

Her hair is dark brown at the top but a lighter orange brown at the bottom. You can draw her hair in braids or down. Please note her pointed ears.

Hello there! I'd love to be considered for a framed headshot!

This would be for my oc Avery! He's funny, a little on the dorky side, and smiles when he's embarrassed :'>

I don't mind which clothing you give him! Thank you for your time <3

https://sta.sh/227jwrv2urq2

Hello! 

I love how soft your art is and would love to get these two characters drawn! Their names are Olwen (24F, 183cm) and Loraine (36F, 170cm). Olwen is young, rich and flirtatious while Loraine is the older, responsible and more down to earth one. Olwen is also more open and prone to teasing while Loraine is more conservative. 

I was thinking of a pose similar to this (https://twitter.com/1L9l2Aa8UCL0IGJ/status/1222161629065834498) but eyes open and looking at each other softly while Loraine is gently cradling Olwen's face. The clothes are up to the artist!

Character References: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1goPbYgPPqSMAU1y5pPlDV5Gsa2WsmLHJ?usp=sharing

Hello, nice to meet you!
I would like to make a request because I like your illustrations very much.

The following is a rough setting of the character.

Gender: Male
Hair: Ash blonde (dark blonde), bangs parted on the left side. (Right side as seen from me)
Eye color: Right eye - light ice color Left eye - blue-purple
Height: 173cm
Personality: Talks and moves a lot. She is a cheerful city girl type who is not intimidated. In reality, he has a two-faced personality and is dark at heart.
Occupation: Sniper Weapon: L96A1 (This is just an image, you can use whatever you like)
Clothing and appearance will be based on the document URL, but you are free to arrange the rest as you wish, as long as you draw the goggles.
We would like to use it as a standing picture for the PBC.

Thank you very much for your consideration.

Hello Petit! I really loved the way you drew me and my partner’s OCs previously, so I was wondering if it would be OK to request them again, this time in your ‘omakase doodle’ page style!

Setting/scene: First date at a cute café 
Mood: Romantic and soft
References: https://sta.sh/22eqf0ncfhht - Alternate date outfit references are included in a folder in the link!

If you would rather not then it is OK to cancel, thank you for your consideration!

Hello, I really love your art! I would like to request two original characters: Dantalion and Uriel. They're a couple who used to have a lot of tension between each other, so it's ok to portray them either tender/lovey or more belligerent.

All references are in this link: https://imgur.com/a/ngrMB0C

Dantalion is the flirtatious and nonchalant type, while Uriel is serious and hotheaded.

Thank you very much!
